title: Effect with Idle Original Tapes
statement: For a Boolean finite Turing machine $M$, any Boolean input word, input-head movement, instructions for the three auxiliary tapes, optional output bit and successor state, and configuration data for the input head, auxiliary tapes, and output, applying the action that leaves every original work tape unchanged yields the configuration with the prescribed successor state, the input head moved by the clamped movement, each auxiliary tape updated at its head when instructed and each auxiliary head moved as prescribed, and the optional output bit appended.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Boolean finite Turing machine
